title: Impact of Currently Recommended Postnatal Nutrition on Neonatal Body Composition
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to gain information that may be useful in helping to figure out better or newer ways to provide nutrition to babies born premature.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Newborns \<32 weeks gestational age, singleton or multiple gestation
* 34-36 weeks gestational age newborns
* Term healthy infants from uncomplicated pregnancy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Babies with life threatening illness unlikely to survive
* Congenital and chromosomal anomalies
study_population: The study group involves premature infants born between 23 to 32 weeks gestation, while babies born at 34 weeks, 36 weeks and ≥37 and ≤ 42 weeks gestational age will serve as control groups.
